verdict.rationale: Google Workspace offers pieces of lifecycle automation. Automatic user provisioning syncs account changes to third-party apps (docs-13/26). Dynamic groups can drive attribute-based membership (docs-30). Apps Script provides low-code automation of Admin console tasks (docs-14/19), alongside Directory APIs for creating and managing users (docs-22). There is no evidence of a no-code, event-triggered workflow builder that orchestrates joiner/mover/leaver steps, so the admin must script or assemble it. Missing for 10: a no-code workflow builder, triggers on hire/role-change/departure events, documented offboarding choreography across apps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
